text:
incident-bot: Pager — HIGH p99 tail latency and spike in 5xx for inference path in az1a. Alert: inference-serving.p95 > 2s. Auto-attaching channel #incidents/az1a

 tanya_oncall: Oncall here, investigating. Can someone grab model load logs and host iostat/dmesg?

 sameer_sre: I see EBS read latency spike on ephemeral host group, multiple `blk_mq` timeouts in dmesg. Quick sample: ```[  +0.000000] nvme0n1: I/O 0 QID 1 timeout, status=D```

 mike_support: Support triage started. Notifying affected customers on Dedicated in az1a. ETA for first customer update 30m.

 linda_eng: Traffic pattern shows many cold model loads. `mmap` failures with EBS read errors when loading weights. Cached quantized variant already present on some hosts.

 tanya_oncall: Plan: 1) block new cold-start model loads in az1a, 2) shift non-realtime traffic to eu-west-1, 3) enable cached q4 variants where possible. Starting reroute now.

 josh_ops: Executing reroute command: `./routerctl route set --from az1a --to eu-west-1 --filter='tier!=realtime' --weight 70`

 incident-bot: Runbook check: enable local fallback, scale ephemeral pool +30%, if EBS errors persist after 10m escalate to infra.

 sameer_sre: Scaled ephemeral fleet +12 instances. 5xx count down but p99 still elevated. EBS read latency ~200-400ms on some hosts.

 linda_eng: Pushed canary to enable in-memory decode for small models to avoid reloads. Canaries at 10% now.

 mike_support: Customer impact update: ~12% of hosted API requests from az1a saw >2s latency; several Dedicated tenants with pinned capacity observed model-load 5xx. Drafting targeted notices.

 tanya_oncall: Handing off to night oncall. @sameer_sre you're primary. I'll recheck at +1h or on escalation.

 sameer_sre: Ack. Continuing mitigation and opening cloud provider support case (case#84412) for EBS backend IO anomalies.

 mike_support: :thumbsup: Placing affected customer list into #support/alerts and starting outbound emails for highest-impact tenants.

 linda_eng: Canary validated. Starting gradual rollout to remaining hosts. If success rate >95% we'll reduce reroute weight.

 incident-bot: Status: error rate down ~65%, p99 in az1a reduced to ~1.6s after rollouts and reroutes. Monitoring window 30m.

 tanya_oncall: Closing on-call loop from my side. Incident classified: partial AZ I/O amplification causing inference model-load failures. Postmortem required, assign to eng-runtime.

 mike_support: Working on customer impact section for postmortem.

 sameer_sre: Action items: add EBS IO headroom metric to inference alerts, evaluate local nvme cache for model artifacts, follow up with cloud provider on case#84412.

 josh_ops: Leaving runbook note: consider auto-fallback to cached variants by default when EBS read latency >100ms.

 incident-bot: Incident moved to monitoring. Thread archived when stable.
